acceptance: Positive primary delta_SR and lower bound of whole-map paired cluster bootstrap 95% CI greater than zero
additional_required_estimand: Equal-map mean difference, reported separately with its whole-map cluster interval
map_sampling: Draw M of M maps uniformly with replacement; keep all episodes in each selected map, including repetitions
episode_weighting: Ratio of sampled map effect sums to sampled map episode counts
interval: Two-sided percentile [2.5%,97.5%], pointwise, no multiplicity adjustment
case_selection: Within each SR improvement/degradation category: descending absolute NE change, prefer different maps, at most two cases per category per split
